body_lead: VIJAYAWADA: C. Raghunatha Reddy, a differently-abled student who secured a seat at NIT Calicut with the intervention of Education and IT Minister Nara Lokesh, has now established an AI startup, becoming an inspiration to many. In July last year, several differently-abled students who had secured seats in prestigious educational institutions across India faced issues in uploading their intermediate board certificates. When this issue was brought to Minister Lokeshâs attention via WhatsApp, he responded swiftly.
